title_sq: Apartament 1+1 per shitje tek Gradient Residence!
description_sq:
Ekskluzivisht ofrojme per shitje apartament 1+1 tek "Gradient Rezidence"
Është një ndërtesë rezidenciale e pozicionuar në Rrugën Liqeni Thate, me pamje te dy liqeneve: Liqenit të Tiranës dhe "Liqeni Thate".
Me një pozicion strategjik dhe afër natyrës, Rezidenca Gradient është një vend ideal për ata që kërkojnë një jetese komode, me lehtësi për tu lidhur me qytetin dhe Parkun e Liqenit.
Gradient Residence zhvillohet ne nje siperfaqe trualli 6189m2 ku struktura e nderteses ze nje siperfaqe prej 1364m2 dhe do te kete nje hapesire te perbashket per komunitetin prej 4825m2 .
Objekti eshte I ndare ne 2 shkalle ku secila disponon 2 ashensore te markes SCHINDLER me kapacitet prej 9 personash.
Cilesia e larte e ndertimit eshte nje faktor I rendesishem qe ben diferencen ne ndertimet ne zone dhe jo vetem per tju siguruar nje jetese te qete dhe komode, duke vene ne dukje izolimin akustik dhe termik I fasades se xhamit apo dritareve, pas testimeve te kryera ne objekt amortizon deri ne 42dB (decibel) .
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e kater teknik me siperfaqe totale 69.8m2, dhe siperfaqe brendshme 55.6m2, e mire shfrytezuar ne nje sallon me ambjent gatimi te perbashket, dhome gjumi, korridor shperndares, tualet dhe ballkon me orientim jug perendim.
Nje mundesi shume e mire per te jetuar ne nje nga zonat me elitare te Tiranes.
Per me teper informacion mos hezitoni te me kontaktoni.
title_en: 1+1 apartment for sale at Gradient Residence!
description_en: We exclusively offer for sale a 1+1 apartment at "Gradient Residence" It is a residential building located on Liqeni Thate Street, overlooking two lakes: Lake Tirana and "Liqeni Thate". With a strategic position and close to nature, Gradient Residence is an ideal place for those looking for a comfortable lifestyle, easily connected to the city and the Lake Park. Gradient Residence is developed on a land area of ​​6189m2 where the structure of the building occupies an area of ​​1364m2 and there will be a common space for the community of 4825m2. The facility is divided into 2 levels, each of which has 2 SCHINDLER elevators with a capacity of 9 people. The high quality of the construction is an important factor that makes the difference in the constructions in the area and not only to ensure a quiet and comfortable life, noting the acoustic and thermal insulation of the glass facade or windows, after the tests carried out in the building it dampens up to 42dB (decibels). The apartment is located on the fourth technical floor with a total area of ​​69.8m2, and an internal area of ​​55.6m2, well used in a living room with a common kitchen area, bedroom, distribution corridor, toilet and balcony with south-west orientation. A very good opportunity to live in one of the most elite areas of Tirana. For more information, do not hesitate to contact me.
